account: This node's objective is a bounded analytical task: produce 3–4 argument points tying specific features of AI image production to kitsch hallmarks in plain, non-drafted prose. All context is fixed by the envelope and user decisions (audience, register, stance, form, title hint), and there are no source materials to gather — the work draws on the writer's own reasoning. The acceptance condition is mechanical (correct count and length, each point explicitly connects one production feature to one kitsch hallmark, no citations, not essay-finished prose), and no sibling's future output is needed. Because expansion_required is false and the task is decidable now, I solve inline rather than spawning children that would only re-assemble content the same bounded task already covers.

synthesis_contract.acceptance_condition: 3–4 numbered points; each point 1–3 plain sentences naming one AI production feature and one kitsch hallmark and stating the connection; total at most 250 words; no citations; not drafted as finished essay prose.
synthesis_contract.conflict_policy: If two points would hinge on the same production feature, keep them distinct by tying that feature to different kitsch hallmarks or vice versa so every argument earns a separate role in the thesis.
synthesis_contract.parent_question: Return 3–4 numbered analytical argument points (1–3 plain sentences each, under 250 words total) that connect specific features of AI art production to specific kitsch hallmarks, for the parent to adopt, temper, or structure into the essay backbone.
